newsitem.title: GERMANY: Eurowings/Gill Airways start London-Hamburg service.
newsitem.headline: Eurowings/Gill Airways start London-Hamburg service.

text.p: German airline Eurowings Luftverkehrs AG said it would start Hamburg-London Stansted flights with UK partner Gill Airways from September 8.
Gill Airways, which already flies a Eurowings code-share service between Newcastle and Duesseldorf, will fly the joint-code route twice-daily on weekdays with an ATR-42 aircraft.
The move came after Air UK announced it would stop flying the route on that date due to revenue-orientated schedule re-structuring.
Air UK, now a 100 percent KLM Royal Dutch Airlines subsidiary, would instead use the Fokker-50 aircraft to increase feeder flights from its 15 UK destinations to Amsterdam, a company statement said.
The other Air UK flights to German destinations, Frankfurt, Duesseldorf and Munich, would be maintained, it stressed.

A Eurowings spokeswoman said: "Stansted airport is very keen to get more traffic, slots are easy to get and we believe there is a market there." - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax 5017 - www.racs.com
